purpose: Reduce redundant SQL-backed session revalidation on read paths while retaining native read authorization and final live revocation checks.
constraints: Root alone publishes after independent source review and exact current head/base CI. No force push, no private customer data, raw SQL/archives, credentials or screenshots in public repository.
No actual DB or native DLL execution, private configuration/security setting changes, or business/runtime activation in this code slice. Preserve all existing tests and disclose unexecuted checks.

Add non-authorizing current-memory session inspection for token existence, expiry/logout and latest frozen identity without SQL/activity/version mutation. Keep full ResolveAsync behavior unchanged. No cross-request authority cache, TTL, fake versions or relaxed native permissions.

Purchase reads use cheap inspection at entry/pre-cleanup and retain fresh full authority revalidation after SQL cleanup; endpoint pre-access can inspect but post-access must revalidate. Preserve midflight revoke/cancel/branch and native credential/grant/schema checks.

Inbound GET may fast-return existing scope-null Closed/Unavailable only when BOTH exact built-in unavailable access and service registrations are present, after normal request authentication/origin/query syntax and current-session validation. No custom-provider shortcut, POST change or protected data/receipt exposure.
Record static SELECT/full-revalidation counts separately from real measured latency. SqlPurchaseRequestQueries overlaps I38 only in disjoint status-projection hunks; root owns composition.
